project_name.justification: The documents consistently refer to the project being acquired as Musselwhite, for example: "Newmont Announces Sale of Musselwhite for up to $850 Million" and "Orla Mining Announces Strategic Expansion into Canada with Acquisition of the Musselwhite Gold Mine".

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified as Orla Mining Ltd. in the text: "Newmont Corporation... announced today that it has agreed to sell its Musselwhite operation in Ontario, Canada, to Orla Mining Ltd (“Orla”) for up to $850 million in total consideration."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Orla Mining, is identified in the text: "- Jason Simpson, President & Chief Executive Officer of Orla".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Orla will acquire a full interest in the project: "Under the terms of the Agreement, Orla will acquire all the outstanding shares of a wholly-owned subsidiary of Newmont that will own a 100% interest in Musselwhite."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is repeatedly identified as a gold mine: "Orla Mining Announces Strategic Expansion into Canada with Acquisition of the Musselwhite Gold Mine".

verified_article_link.justification: The provided articles are all relevant to the acquisition of the Musselwhite project by Orla Mining from Newmont.

currency.justification: The currency is specified as U.S. dollars: "All amounts expressed in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated".

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total consideration is up to $850 million, composed of an upfront payment and contingent payments. The text states: "Newmont will receive cash consideration of $810 million upon closing and up to $40 million1 in contingent payments." The total aggregated cash payment is $810,000,000 + $40,000,000 = $850,000,000.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction did not involve shares as payment to the seller. The text states: "There is no upfront equity dilution associated with the Transaction."

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Explicit cash payment values were found, so this field is null per the financial data extraction hierarchy.
